assessment.rationale: The supplied records provide both financial/adoption-relevant burdens and enablers, but the frozen deployment context is missing the specific budget, organization, infrastructure, and region details needed to make a deployment-specific feasibility judgment. General evidence shows insider-threat mitigation can be cost-prohibitive and ROI-sensitive (E_22), cryptography implementation is conditioned on organization-defined uses and applicable standards/policies (E_25), insider-threat program assessment involves personnel, legal, and security/privacy roles (E_26), and related control guidance involves automated maintenance and stakeholder updates (E_20). General evidence also shows adoption-relevant enablers such as increasing publication activity for CRYPTOGRAPHY (E_33), digital-signature capability (E_16), recognized control terminology (E_23), and control uses for cryptography (E_25). Because these are general and contextual rather than deployment-specific financial/adoption measurements, and because the deployment context is unknown, the action is neither materially supported nor materially challenged under this lens.
